facts.claim: Ueno Park is beside Ueno Station, with museums and Shinobazu Pond. Cherry blossom viewing is associated with spring; lotuses with summer.
facts.sourceHeading: Seasonal flowers, a zoo, and more at Ueno Park
facts.evidenceExcerpt: Shinobazu Pond to shoot the lotuses during the summer

facts.claim: Tokyo National Museum presents Japanese and other Asian artworks and antiquities including prints, ceramics and swords.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: ukiyo-e woodblock prints, ceramics and swords
